---
name: Bug report
about: Report a problem with the MCP connection, plugin, CLI, SDK or hosted API.
labels: bug
---

## What happened?

Describe what you expected and what happened instead.

## How can we reproduce it?

Include the smallest command, SDK example or agent prompt that shows the problem.
For a video problem, describe the input and affected edit; a public sample is useful.

## Environment

- Surface: MCP / plugin / CLI / SDK / REST API
- Client and version:
- CueFrame package or plugin version:
- Operating system and Node.js version, when relevant:
- Request ID (`x-request-id`), if available:

## Logs or screenshots

Include the error and relevant output. Omit API keys, access tokens, private media
and customer data. Report vulnerabilities through [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/cueframe-ai/cueframe-mcp/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
